spec: specification/effects.mdx, One-Shot Delimited Continuations: the compiler may choose any representation satisfying the request/handler contract; compatibility.mdx, shared-syntax semantics
prelude: import { Context } from 'vibelang/context'; import { Layer } from 'vibelang/provider'; import { Panic, panic } from 'vibelang:exceptions'; class Boom extends Error {} abstract class C extends Context { abstract value(): number }

cases.name: annotated success
cases.source: function read(n: number): Result<number, Boom> { return n + 1; } export function main() { return String(read(6).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: direct failure
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { throw new Boom('missing'); } export function main() { return read().match({ ok: String, error: e => e.message }); }

cases.name: branching success and failure
cases.source: function read(n: number): Result<number, Boom> { if (n < 0) throw new Boom('negative'); return n; } export function main() { return [read(7).unwrapOr(0), read(-1).unwrapOr(2)].join(','); }

cases.name: forwarded result
cases.source: function leaf(): Result<number, Boom> { return 7; } function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return leaf(); } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: mutable locals and loops
cases.source: function read(n: number): Result<number, Boom> { let total = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) total += i; return total; } export function main() { return String(read(4).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: native async awaits
cases.source: async function read(): Promise<Result<number, Boom>> { const n = await Promise.resolve(6); return n + 1; } export async function main() { const result = await read(); return String(result.unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: method receiver and arguments
cases.source: class Box { value = 6; read(n: number): Result<number, Boom> { return this.value + arguments.length + n; } } export function main() { return String(new Box().read(2).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: arrow lexical receiver
cases.source: class Box { value = 7; read = (): Result<number, Boom> => this.value; } export function main() { return String(new Box().read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: recursive named function expression
cases.source: const read = function self(n: number): Result<number, Boom> { if (n > 0) return self(n - 1); return 7; }; export function main() { return String(read(3).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: finally runs before result observation
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; function read(): Result<number, Boom> { try { return 7; } finally { seen.push('cleanup'); } } export function main() { const value = read().unwrapOr(0); return [String(value), ...seen].join(','); }

cases.name: pending panic protection survives frame elision
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { try { panic('original panic'); } finally { return 7; } } export function main() { try { read().unwrapOr(0); return 'swallowed'; } catch (error) { return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'not-error'; } }

cases.name: resource disposal survives frame elision
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { seen.push('dispose'); } } function read(): Result<number, Boom> { using resource = new Resource(); return 7; } export function main() { const value = read().unwrapOr(0); return [String(value), ...seen].join(','); }

cases.name: super keeps its authored receiver
cases.source: class Base { value = 6; valueOf() { return this.value; } } class Box extends Base { read(): Result<number, Boom> { return super.valueOf() + 1; } } export function main() { return String(new Box().read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: generic result contract
cases.source: function read<T>(value: T): Result<T, Boom> { return value; } export function main() { return read('seven').unwrapOr('missing'); }

cases.name: implicit void completion
cases.source: function read(): Result<void, Boom> { const n = 7; void n; } export function main() { return String(read().isOk()); }

cases.name: a conservatively emitted propagation keeps its delimiter
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, never> { return 7; } function outer(): Result<number, Boom> { return read()!; } export function main() { return String(outer().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: propagation keeps a delimiter
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { throw new Boom('missing'); } function outer(): Result<number, Boom> { return read()! + 1; } export function main() { return String(outer().unwrapOr(7)); }

cases.name: expect keeps a delimiter
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return 7; } function outer(): Result<number, Panic> { return read().expect('missing'); } export function main() { return String(outer().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: capability request retains the required calling convention
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return C.context().value(); } export function main() { return String(Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { value: () => 7 }), () => read().unwrapOr(0))); }

cases.name: inferred result keeps its merged completion contract
cases.source: function read(n: number) { if (n < 0) throw new Boom('negative'); return n; } export function main() { return [read(7).unwrapOr(0), read(-1).unwrapOr(2)].join(','); }

cases.name: nested suspension conservatively retains a delimiter
cases.source: function leaf(): Result<number, Boom> { return 7; } function read(): Result<number, Boom> { function inner(): Result<number, Boom> { return leaf()!; } return inner(); } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: wrong success type stays refused
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return 'wrong'; } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: foreign invalid completion is checked after finally
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; export function trace() { return seen.join(','); } export function main(value: Result<number, Boom>): Result<number, Boom> { try { return value; } finally { seen.push('cleanup'); } }
cases.expected: a function with a non-empty failure row completed without a Result,cleanup

cases.name: finally can replace an invalid foreign ordinary return
cases.source: export function main(value: Result<number, Boom>): Result<number, Boom> { try { return value; } finally { return 7; } }

cases.name: async invalid completion is checked after awaited cleanup
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; export function trace() { return seen.join(','); } export async function main(value: Result<number, Boom>): Promise<Result<number, Boom>> { try { return value; } finally { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push('cleanup'); } }
cases.expected: a function with a non-empty failure row completed without a Result,cleanup

cases.name: async finally replaces an invalid foreign ordinary return
cases.source: export async function main(value: Result<number, Boom>): Promise<Result<number, Boom>> { try { return value; } finally { await Promise.resolve(); return 7; } }

cases.name: invalid completion is checked after resource disposal
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; export function trace() { return seen.join(','); } class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { seen.push('dispose'); } } export function main(value: Result<number, Boom>): Result<number, Boom> { using resource = new Resource(); return value; }
cases.expected: a function with a non-empty failure row completed without a Result,dispose

cases.name: implicit undefined success is not a lexical identifier
cases.source: function read(undefined: number): Result<void, Boom> { void undefined; } export function main() { return String(read(7).unwrapOr(undefined) === undefined); }

cases.name: bare return success is not a lexical identifier
cases.source: function read(undefined: number): Result<void, Boom> { void undefined; return; } export function main() { return String(read(7).unwrapOr(undefined) === undefined); }

cases.name: a shadowed undefined cannot create a pending panic
cases.source: function read(undefined: number): Result<number, Boom> { try { return 7; } finally { void undefined; } } export function main() { return String(read(7).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: a shadowed undefined cannot create a pending panic in a delimiter
cases.source: function leaf(): Result<number, Boom> { return 7; } function read(undefined: number): Result<number, Boom> { try { return leaf()!; } finally { void undefined; } } export function main() { return String(read(7).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: missing number completion stays refused
cases.source: function read(): Result<number, Boom> {} export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: async resource disposal needs no generator frame
cases.source: const seen: string[] = []; class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push('dispose'); } } async function read(): Promise<Result<number, Boom>> { await using resource = new Resource(); return 7; } export async function main() { const value = (await read()).unwrapOr(0); return [String(value), ...seen].join(','); }

cases.name: an omitted panic argument does not read a shadowed undefined
cases.source: function read(undefined: number): Result<number, Panic> { void undefined; panic(); } export function main() { return read(7).match({ ok: () => 'unchecked', error: error => String(error.cause === undefined) }); }

cases.name: completion imports do not collide with authored module names
cases.source: const __vsCompleteResult = 3; const __vibelangCompleteResult = 4; function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return __vsCompleteResult + __vibelangCompleteResult; } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: parameters cannot capture the completion import
cases.source: function read(__vsCompleteResult: number, __vibelangCompleteResult: number): Result<number, Boom> { return __vsCompleteResult + __vibelangCompleteResult; } export function main() { return String(read(3, 4).unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: completion alias allocation checks generated-looking suffixes
cases.source: const __vsCompleteResult = 1, __vsCompleteResult_1 = 2; const __vibelangCompleteResult = 1, __vibelangCompleteResult_1 = 3; function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return __vsCompleteResult + __vsCompleteResult_1 + __vibelangCompleteResult + __vibelangCompleteResult_1; } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }

cases.name: variant imports share the same hygienic allocation
cases.source: const __vibelangOk = 7; function read(): Result<number, Boom> { return __vibelangOk; } export function main() { return String(read().unwrapOr(0)); }
